title: Egyptian Chicken Tagine
description: A classic North African dish made with chicken, aromatic spices, and a flavorful tagine sauce, perfect for a keto diet.

ingredients.name: aromatic
ingredients.notes: ground ginger, ground cumin, ground coriander

ingredients.name: tagine
ingredients.notes: ground spices, typically includes cinnamon, ginger, coriander, and cumin

instructions: Season the chicken thighs with salt and pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the chicken thighs until browned on both sides. Remove from heat and set aside.
Add the aromatic spices to the pot and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the egyptian spices, chicken broth, and tomato paste to the pot. Stir to combine.
Return the chicken thighs to the pot and bring to a simmer.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and cook for 30 minutes.
While the chicken is cooking, prepare the tagine sauce. In a small bowl, mix together the tagine spices and a pinch of salt.
Remove the pot from the oven and stir in the tagine sauce.
Serve the chicken thighs with the tagine sauce spooned over the top.
